mechanism_narrative: A quarterly increase in GDPC1 exceeding 2% YoY signals strengthening economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 50% of quarters with GDPC1 YoY growth > 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained FEDFUNDS rate below 4% indicates accommodative monetary policy, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns during accommodative periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When UNRATE falls below 4%, signaling a tight labor market, and PAYEMS growth exceeds 200k YoY, the S&P 500 experiences positive forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC for this mechanism remains below 0.01 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in INDPRO exceeding 1.5% YoY signals strengthening industrial production, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 40% of instances with INDPRO YoY growth > 1.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in HOUST exceeding 10% YoY signals a housing market boom, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns during housing booms are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS rises above 5%, signaling monetary tightening, and CPIAUCSL growth exceeds 3% YoY, the S&P 500 experiences negative forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC for this mechanism remains below 0.02 over any 18-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained UNRATE above 5% indicates a slack labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns during labor market slack are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When RSAFS growth exceeds 5% YoY and GDPC1 growth is below 1% YoY, the S&P 500 experiences negative forward returns over the next 5 trading days due to potential economic slowdown.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS YoY growth > 5% and GDPC1 YoY growth < 1%
failure_condition: Rank IC for this mechanism remains below 0.015 over any 12-month rolling window.
